author: Bill Ferguson
name: select_raw_non_raw
description: Adds two buttons to select either the raw or the non-raw images within the current collection.
description-extensive: This add-on gives you two simple buttons to instantly pick out just the raw files, or just the non-raw files like JPEGs, from your current group of photos. It makes sorting through mixed shoots much faster when you want to work on one type at a time. No extra software is needed.
